description: Capture two URLs and compare them pixel by pixel. Returns a similarity score and an overlay image marking what changed, which you can look at. Costs 2 credits - it launches a browser per URL. Use for staging against production, or a page before and after a change.

threshold.description: Per-pixel colour tolerance. Higher ignores more, e.g. antialiasing differences.

name: compare_pages
title: Compare two pages visually
